verdict.rationale: Raygun's AI Error Resolution offers chat-based suggestions on root cause and how to fix errors, and Raygun separately integrates with GitHub, Bitbucket and GitLab for source context. Nothing in the evidence shows the AI drafting a code change or opening a pull request for human review. Chat suggestions are an adjacent feature, not the PR-based fix workflow this story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the platform's AI can draft a code fix for an error and open a pull request against my repo for human review
